html:
G'oya

Har bir bola uchun ikkita qiymat kerak: vazn yozilgan eng erta kundagi vazn va eng kech kundagi vazn. Ikkalasini korrelyatsiyalangan skalyar subquery bilan olamiz: bolaning vaznli qatorlarini sanaga ko'ra saralab, birinchisini. Keyin ularni solishtiramiz.

Yechim

WITH w AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT child_id,
    (SELECT a.weight_g FROM checkups a
     WHERE a.child_id = c.child_id AND a.weight_g IS NOT NULL
     ORDER BY a.check_date
     LIMIT 1) AS first_weight,
    (SELECT b.weight_g FROM checkups b
     WHERE b.child_id = c.child_id AND b.weight_g IS NOT NULL
     ORDER BY b.check_date DESC
     LIMIT 1) AS last_weight
  FROM checkups c
)
SELECT child_id, first_weight, last_weight
FROM w
WHERE last_weight < first_weight

DISTINCT har bir bolani bir marta qoldiradi. Vazni bir marta o'lchangan bolada ikkala qiymat bir xil, < rost emas. Hech o'lchanmagan bolada ikkalasi NULL, u ham chiqmaydi.

Tuzoqlar

Ichki so'rovlardagi weight_g IS NOT NULL sharti masalaning yuragi. Usiz 2-bola uchun "birinchi vazn" sentyabrdagi NULL bo'ladi, 3-bola uchun "oxirgi vazn" noyabrdagi NULL. Solishtirish NULL beradi va vazni aniq kamaygan ikki bola ro'yxatdan tushib qoladi:

Noto'g'riWITH w AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT child_id,
    (SELECT a.weight_g FROM checkups a
     WHERE a.child_id = c.child_id
     ORDER BY a.check_date LIMIT 1) AS first_weight,
    (SELECT b.weight_g FROM checkups b
     WHERE b.child_id = c.child_id
     ORDER BY b.check_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_weight
  FROM checkups c
)
SELECT child_id, first_weight, last_weight
FROM w
WHERE last_weight < first_weight

MIN(weight_g) va MAX(weight_g) ni solishtirish boshqa savolga javob beradi: "vazn qachondir o'zgarganmi". 4-bola oktyabrda 200 gramm yo'qotib, keyin tiklagan, u ro'yxatga tushmasligi kerak.

Boshqa yo'l

Avval har bola uchun vaznli kunlarning eng ertasi va eng kechini topib, shu kunlardagi qatorlarni ulash:

SELECT m.child_id, f.weight_g AS first_weight, l.weight_g AS last_weight
FROM (
  SELECT child_id, MIN(check_date) AS d1, MAX(check_date) AS d2
  FROM checkups
  WHERE weight_g IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY child_id
) m
JOIN checkups f ON f.child_id = m.child_id AND f.check_date = m.d1
JOIN checkups l ON l.child_id = m.child_id AND l.check_date = m.d2
WHERE l.weight_g < f.weight_g

Bu yerda ham NULL filtri bor, faqat u bitta joyda: sanalar hisoblanishidan oldin.
